historical_reproduction_binding: Frozen findings are reviews-5e4ef52 Luna findings 2/4, Sol findings 1/5, and filesystem_durability/recovery_authority reproductions.
The three pre-repair test errors were probes for the absent durability helper; the four failures independently reproduced ordering, failure propagation, and fork ownership defects.
No contract, SSOT, human acceptance artifact, topic_observation.py file, or unrelated test was edited.

durability: Artifact blob and artifact manifest each fsync file content before replace and fsync the immediate parent after replace.
Observation manifest uses the same durable atomic replacement path.
New nested directories are created one component at a time and each mkdir fsyncs its immediate parent.
Candidate artifact and observation maps are assigned only after their manifest replacement and parent fsync return successfully.
Unrenamed temporary files are cleaned on failure; a post-rename fsync failure leaves the renamed target in place.
fork_lock: Thread-local lock state is reset when the process ID changes.
Child processes cannot reuse inherited logical ownership or topic transaction authority.
An inherited context finalizer skips LOCK_UN in a child whose owner PID differs.
green_proof.tests: 20 requested tests, 7 focused tests, and 94 related tests passed with zero skips.

remaining_risks: No physical power-loss or filesystem-specific crash injection was performed; the proof is syscall-order and failure-injection based.
A post-rename fsync failure can leave an unreferenced durable blob or an uncertain manifest generation by design; garbage collection and recovery policy remain outside this defect scope.
Full repository CI and remote GitHub staging were not run because this task explicitly forbids network, commits, branches, and Git metadata writes.
acceptance_self_check_details: Implementation scope, frozen hashes, red proof, green proof, failure propagation, PID-bound fork behavior, and non-approval boundary were checked.
failure_origin: Remote main 517f44a472d56c4e1c733fc02ea97f45d15c5eca exposed ordinary blob and manifest writes without durable fsync ordering, map publication before durable manifest completion, and inherited thread-local literature lock ownership across fork.
